backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining data types and storage maps for user profiles, fasting schedules, nutrition, sleep, movement, and stress entries, with access-controlled CRUD query/update methods for each domain.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the requirement to remove the 'Heute', 'Diese Woche', and 'Aktuelle Serie' metrics from IntermittentFastingPanel while keeping the rest of the panel intact, with associated file and component references.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted catalogue of short summaries for each frontend source file, describing the purpose and recent changes of components, hooks, utilities, and configuration files.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based design tokens for light and dark themes including colors, radius, chart, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the LivSpan app that forces dark mode on load via an inline script and mounts the React app at the root div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component wrapping the app in ThemeProvider and LanguageProvider, showing a branded LoadingScreen during auth/profile initialization before rendering StartDashboard.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Button component handling Internet Identity login and logout with loading state, styled with helix gradient classes and i18n labels.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Factor: Interactive card component for health factor selection, using green-blue gradient backgrounds and radial overlays to indicate selected vs. unselected states with hover animations.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Fastin: Card component for viewing and editing the user's fasting schedule (start/end hours), persisting changes via a save mutation and notifying the parent of schedule updates.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Interm: Dashboard panel that displays the user's intermittent fasting status, live countdown timer, and progress bar based on their saved fasting schedule, with a settings component for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Moveme: Dashboard panel for logging daily physical activity, allowing authenticated users to select activity type, intensity, and active minutes, then save the entry via a React Query mutation.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Nutrit: Dashboard panel for tracking daily nutrition including calories, protein, and water intake, with BMI/protein target calculations derived from the user's profile and fasting schedule.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/SleepP: Dashboard panel for logging daily sleep duration and quality score using gradient sliders, with progress toward an 8-hour goal and save functionality for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Stress: Dashboard panel for recording daily cardiovascular stress metrics (blood pressure and pulse), displaying a summary readout and saving data for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/genome/AnimatedH: Renders a full-screen SVG animated DNA double helix background with two strand paths, connecting base pairs, and glowing accent nodes using CSS animations and SVG filters.
frontend/src/components/genome/HelixSpin: A layout wrapper that renders a centered vertical DNA helix SVG (two strands with base pairs) behind its children, used to visually frame genome factor markers.
frontend/src/components/i18n/LanguageSwi: A toggle button component that switches the app language between English and German, highlighting the active language using the i18n context.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileO: A gate component that shows a login prompt for unauthenticated users or a profile setup dialog for users without a saved profile, before rendering its children.
frontend/src/hooks/queryKeys.ts: Defines and exports centralized React Query cache key constants for user profile, fasting schedule, nutrition, sleep, movement, and stress queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFastingScheduleQue: Provides React Query hooks to fetch and save the caller's fasting schedule via the backend actor, with toast notifications on success or error.
frontend/src/hooks/useFastingWindowTimer: A hook that calculates and updates every second the current fasting or eating phase, elapsed/remaining time, and progress percentage based on a configurable schedule.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient creation with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useMovementQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and saving a user's movement day entry by date, using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and saving today's nutrition entry for the authenticated user via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSleepQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and saving today's sleep entry for the authenticated user via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useStressQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and saving a user's stress day entry by date, using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfileQueries: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and saving the current user's profile via the backend actor, with actor-dependent loading state.
frontend/src/i18n/LanguageProvider.tsx: React context provider that manages the app's active language (English/German), persisting the selection to localStorage and auto-detecting browser language.
frontend/src/i18n/translations.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and translation objects for English and German, covering all UI text across the application's panels and features.
frontend/src/i18n/useI18n.ts: Custom hook that exposes the LanguageContext, providing access to the current language, setter, and translation strings.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file defining Tailwind directives and a comprehensive OKLCH-based design token system for light and dark modes, including color palettes, gradients, and chart colors.
frontend/src/lib/nutritionCalculations.t: Pure utility functions for client-side nutrition calculations including BMI, protein target, progress percentages, and water intake, with safe number parsing helpers.
frontend/src/lib/nutritionGuidance.ts: Analyzes macro nutrient distribution (calories, protein, fat, carbs) and returns a deterministic guidance key for i18n lookup, covering cases like low/high protein, fat/carb dominance, calorie mismatch, and balanced distribution.
frontend/src/lib/timeFormat.ts: Provides two utility functions for formatting time: one converts seconds to HH:MM:SS string, and another formats hours as a decimal with 'h' suffix.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a single `cn` utility function that merges Tailwind CSS class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that mounts the root component wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/StartDashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page rendering a DNA helix-themed layout with selectable health factor panels (nutrition, sleep, movement, stress, fasting), a header with login and language switcher, and a profile onboarding gate.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining a custom design system with helix-themed colors, sage/teal palettes using oklch variables, custom fonts (Inter, JetBrains Mono), and keyframe animations for helix glow and breathing effects.
project_state.json: Project state metadata for LivSpan tracking current version, existing features, and a pending request to remove three fasting evaluation metrics ('Heute', 'Diese Woche', 'Aktuelle Serie') from the IntermittentFastingPanel component.
